blocks.text: Bogotá: people in the square in front of the cathedral’s stone façade

After breakfast, meet your English-speaking guide and leave Bogotá for a full-day excursion.

First, head to Lake Guatavita, about 57 km from the capital at an elevation of around 3,100 metres. The lake is associated with the legend of El Dorado. According to the legend, when a new cacique took power, the chief travelled to the middle of the lake on a raft and plunged into the water while his attendants threw small gold figures called tunjos into the lake.

The story of the treasure drew many expeditions to Guatavita in search of gold on the lake bed. Today, the lake remains an important natural and historical stop on the itinerary.

From Guatavita, continue to Zipaquirá, a drive of about 1.5 hours. Here you’ll visit the Catedral de Sal, a cathedral carved into solid salt about 180 metres below ground.

After visiting the cathedral, you’ll have time to walk around Zipaquirá and buy souvenirs. Then have lunch at a restaurant before returning to Bogotá and transferring to your hotel.
Bogotá to Medellín, El Peñón and Guatapé

At the scheduled time, transfer to the airport for your flight to Medellín. On arrival, meet your English-speaking guide and drive to El Peñón de Guatapé.

The rock stands between El Peñol and Guatapé. The Tahamí people regarded it as sacred. A local legend tells of Batolito, a fish that protected people from the wrath of the gods in the sky and turned to stone.

El Peñón rises about 220 metres. Much of the rock lies underground, and it is estimated to be more than 70 million years old. The site has been under government protection since the 1940s. The first ascent took place in 1954 and lasted 5 days.

From the heights, you can see green hills and bodies of water. Near the entrance, you can try fruit beer. Continue to Guatapé, known for its colourful façades and relief panels depicting scenes from everyday life. You’ll have time to walk around and have a coffee.

After the tour, return to Medellín, check in at your hotel and relax.
